Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

We acknowledge your offer and the supporting breakdown of cost drivers.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months, 6,110 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 356.33 per unit, 90 days net, no price-adjustment clause. This amounts to about EUR 2,177,176 over the term.
3. Basis: Our demand forecast for this part is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09), and we commit 6,110 units a year. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains.
We have verified the adjustment in the PPI-C241 index and your increased volume commitment, allowing us to pass on the associated cost reductions.
To realize these savings in the unit price, we must maintain our standard payment terms of 30 days net, as a 90-day term would offset the reduction.
Consequently, we propose a revised price of €368.42 per unit under the condition of 30 days net.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €370.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.

We are prepared to accept your requested payment terms of 90 days net, although this extended period restricts our ability to offer further price concessions.
Consequently, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 370.85, reflecting both the updated material costs and the extended payment terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
